prompt: Build a three-row label/field form with GridBagLayout, giving each component its own GridBagConstraints: labels at gridx 0 anchored WEST, fields at gridx 1 with weightx 1.0 and fill HORIZONTAL, and a Save button anchored EAST on row 3.
explanation: GridBagLayout is the only standard layout where each child carries its own constraints object, passed as the second argument to add. weightx decides who receives leftover horizontal space, so giving it only to the fields is what pins the label column to its natural width while the fields stretch. fill and anchor answer two different questions -- fill says whether a component grows to fill its cell, anchor says where it sits when it does not -- and insets add the breathing room around each cell.
hints: setLayout(new GridBagLayout()) first, then build a GridBagConstraints for each component and pass it to add(component, constraints).
Give each component a fresh GridBagConstraints (or reset every field you care about) -- reusing one object silently carries values over.
GridBagConstraints.WEST, EAST, NONE and HORIZONTAL are the constants for anchor and fill; insets take a new Insets(top, left, bottom, right).
